newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,12-mo T-bills yields same or higher.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,12-mo T-bills yields same or higher.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.30 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 26, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 38.211 million UAH 40.505 million UAH
Actual amount raised 33.435 million UAH 35.442 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 382,108 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 275,451 were competitive and 106,657 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is October 2.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged up to 59.90 percent from 59.57 percent at the last sale on September 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 7.089 million UAH 230,100 UAH
The central bank sold 92,070 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 74,113 were competitive and 17,957 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is October 2.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged up to 62.77 percent from 62.11 percent at the last sale on September 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 1,285 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 500 were competitive and 785 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is October 2.
